content:
[L] high | window top edge | "Settings" title and subtitle are clipped at the very top of the window, with text touching the border and no top padding.
[L] high | bottom of window | the last toggle row "Automatic draft replies" is cut off at the window's bottom edge, indicating unresolved content overflow.
[S] high | Data retention card | two explanatory paragraphs run flush to the card's right edge at different widths ("...pruned by this setting." wraps awkwardly; compliance text nearly touches the border) — inconsistent internal padding.
[S] med | form column | input widths are inconsistent (numeric fields ~107px, Agent language ~222px, dropdowns ~160px), so the control column edges do not align.
[S] med | Data retention card | retention paragraph text is cramped at near-zero line spacing with almost no padding from card edges, unlike the airy Sync section above.
[S] med | section cards | uneven vertical gaps between the Sync card, Data retention card, and AI behaviour card; AI behaviour section appears to have no card container while others do.
[H] med | whole page | nearly all text is the same small grey weight — section headings ("Synchronization", "Data retention", "AI behaviour") barely distinguishable from body/labels.
[H] med | AI behaviour section | toggle rows have labels only, no descriptions or grouping, and toggles are pushed to the extreme right edge with no right margin.
[H] low | Sync form | label/value pairs are weakly paired — labels sit far left while inputs float at an arbitrary column with no visible grid alignment.
[C] med | right half of screen | the entire right ~60% of the Sync and Data retention cards is dead empty whitespace while all controls crush into the left 25%.
[C] med | Data retention card | dense run-on legal-style paragraphs mixed with form controls at equal visual weight; reads like debug/developer notes, not product copy.
[C] low | tab bar | tabs are plain grey text with only a thin underline for the active tab; no container or separation from the content below, reading as unfinished.

VERDICT: unprofessional — clipped title, cut-off content, crushed left-heavy layout, and uniform grey typography make this read as a debug tool, not a product.
